title: DEVON ENERGY CORP/DE 8-K Filing — 2026-04-10
summary: Devon Energy Corporation filed an 8-K on April 10, 2026, disclosing unaudited pro forma combined financial information in connection with the previously announced proposed merger with Coterra Energy Inc. The filing includes pro forma combined balance sheet as of December 31, 2025, pro forma combined statement of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025, and notes including supplemental pro forma oil and natural gas reserves information.
key_points: Devon Energy Corporation is filing this 8-K in connection with a proposed merger where Coterra Energy Inc. will become a wholly-owned subsidiary of Devon
The merger is subject to terms and conditions set forth in the merger agreement
Pro forma combined balance sheet as of December 31, 2025 is included
Pro forma combined statement of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 is included
Notes include supplemental pro forma oil and natural gas reserves information
Filing signed by Jeffrey L. Ritenour, Executive Vice President and CFO on April 10, 2026
why_it_matters: This 8-K filing is a required SEC disclosure for a corporate M&A transaction between two energy companies. It does not relate to market structure or macro catalysts. It is relevant only to investors in Devon Energy (DVN) and Coterra Energy, and does not constitute a policy event or market-moving catalyst.
